faqs.question: What is Woot Health?
faqs.answer: Woot Health is a health technology platform that gives individuals and families access to affordable healthcare through retail and business health plans, telemedicine, and a nationwide provider network.

faqs.question: Who can use Woot Health?
faqs.answer: Anyone can sign up, including individuals, families, freelancers, students, and small business owners.

faqs.question: What does the Woot Health retail plan include?
faqs.answer: Retail plans offer access to telemedicine, diagnostics, prescriptions, hospital services, and preventive care depending on the plan selected.

faqs.question: How long is the plan valid?
faqs.answer: Plans are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or change my plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can request a plan upgrade at any time from your dashboard. Once activated, your health plan resets and starts a new cycle.

faqs.question: What is the Woot Wallet?
faqs.answer: The Woot Wallet is a pre-funded digital wallet used to pay for services once your plan limit is exhausted.

faqs.question: How do I top up my wallet?
faqs.answer: Wallet top-ups can be done via the app or dashboard using card payments and bank transfers.

faqs.question: What happens when my plan limit finishes?
faqs.answer: You can continue accessing services by paying through your Woot Wallet.

faqs.question: How do I book a virtual consultation?
faqs.answer: Log into your account, select Consult a Doctor, choose a time, and confirm your appointment.

faqs.question: What types of doctors are available?
faqs.answer: General practitioners, mental health professionals, and other specialists depending on availability.

faqs.question: Are virtual consultations available 24/7?
faqs.answer: Yes, telemedicine services are available round the clock.

faqs.question: How do I find a hospital or provider near me?
faqs.answer: Use the provider search on the website or app to filter by location, specialty, or service type.

faqs.question: Can I walk into any hospital?
faqs.answer: Only hospitals within the Woot provider network are covered. Out-of-network visits are paid through the Woot Wallet.

faqs.question: How do I submit a reimbursement request?
faqs.answer: Upload your receipt, medical report, and required documents through your dashboard or app.

faqs.question: How long does it take to process claims?
faqs.answer: Claims are typically reviewed within 10–15 working days.

faqs.question: Can I get reimbursed for out-of-pocket expenses?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the expenses fall under your plan coverage and supporting documents are submitted. Reimbursement is based on the agreed tariff.

faqs.question: Can I add family members to my plan?
faqs.answer: Yes, dependents can be added from your dashboard under Add Dependents.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email.

faqs.question: Is my health data safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Woot Health complies with global health data standards and uses encryption to protect your information.

faqs.question: Do you share my data with anyone?
faqs.answer: Data is shared only with healthcare providers involved in your care and never for marketing without consent.

faqs.question: How do I reach customer support?
faqs.answer: Customer support is available via live chat, email, or the support section on the app.

faqs.question: What are your support hours?
faqs.answer: Support is available 24/7.

faqs.question: What makes Woot Health different from other providers?
faqs.answer: Woot Health combines affordability, digital access, nationwide provider reach, transparent pricing, and a wallet system that keeps users covered even after plan limits are used.
